business_problem: Metrovacesa needed to qualify thousands of property leads around the clock because manual call-center processes could not keep up with multilingual demand or high-conversion off-hours interactions.
solution_summary: Metrovacesa uses Dialogflow CX, Vertex AI, Gemini, and Vertex AI Search to support multi-agent lead qualification and property support. Metrovacesa needed to qualify thousands of property leads around the clock because manual call-center processes could not keep up with multilingual demand or high-conversion off-hours interactions. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Vertex AI Search, coordinates repeatable workflows with Dialogflow CX, runs transformation or AI logic on Vertex AI, and delivers outputs through Dynamics 365 CRM. Lead, conversation, and crm data are consolidated into Vertex AI Search; pipeline execution is coordinated with Dialogflow CX; Vertex AI applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Dynamics 365 CRM.
